statement: The batch-1 seat-2 constant-last-place anomaly (mean_rank 4.0 in all 16 games) is caused by duel-hardcoded doctrine geometry (march target (-4,3) sitting beside seat-2 territory), not by doctrine quality.
prediction: After the geometry seam (3015cb4), the same 16-game baseline shows seat-2 mean_rank < 3.5 (was 4.0) and seat spread across seats shrinks.

outcome.secondary: with the seat confound removed the doctrine gap widened: turtler mean_rank 1.75 (14 wins) vs expansionist 3.25 (2 wins); pre-seam 2.31 vs 2.66
outcome.residual: seat2 remains mildly elevated (2.875 vs ~2.37 pooled elsewhere) - n=16, descriptive only; candidate for a later paired test if it persists across rosters

statement: settler_broker loses because of a self-inflicted purchase-gate interaction, not income: the gate (scripted.py, turn%3==0, gold>=120) fires while SETTLER (160 gold) is unaffordable, and the next preference GRANARY (exactly 120) spends the settler bank before it can ever reach 160 on a gate turn.
prediction: If the purchase step holds gold below a bank floor until the top purchase preference is affordable (bank_floor=160 for settler_broker), it founds >=3 cities by turn 25 in the large majority of games and mean_rank improves by >=0.5; granary purchases drop to near zero.

test.param: purchase bank floor (scripted.py gate, needs a doctrine-level opt-in field)

outcome.gold_peaks: 148-213; clears 160 in 13/16 games - the bank CAN fire
outcome.verdict: mechanism real, outcome refuted: the gate was not the binding constraint on expansion; founding-space competition (H3) dominates gold banking

evidence: batch-002 trajectories: cities flat at 2 in every inspected match while gold sawtooths 38-173 and CLEARS 160 between gate turns (t=25: 162, t=35: 173 in batch-002-s300003-r2); drops of ~110-120 gold right after gate turns match GRANARY purchases exactly (rules.py purchase_cost = 2x production: SETTLER 160, GRANARY 120)

statement: hyperwide_flood's batch-002 dominance was opposition-dependent, not thesis-achieved: its expected signature (5-6 cities by t30) never materialized in ANY game across batches 002 and 003 (peak 3 cities; founding space exhausts at 4 seats). Against a defender-competent field it collapses and converts production to units.
prediction: In any roster containing turtler or a turtler-like defense plus a second early expander, static hyperwide_flood finishes below both; its unit count exceeds 2x its city count by t60.
evidence: batch-003: flood 1 win / mean_rank 2.625 vs turtler 2.0 and flood_pivot 1.5; deep-dive audit execution score 3/10, thesis missed by 100% of games across both batches

statement: Pivot value is dominated by trigger source and timing, not by the pivot itself: state-triggered early pivots (pressure detection t10-t30) beat both static parents; clock-triggered late pivots (t30 with no threat check) lose to both.
prediction: Adding hysteresis (dwell time or 2-consecutive-check triggers) to flood_pivot removes its t20-t40 oscillations and improves mean_rank further; moving turtle_pivot's switch to a state signal at t12-18 lifts it above static turtler.

outcome.hysteresis_proxy: flood_pivot_sticky (single min_foreign_units_seen>=1 trigger, memoryless stickiness): 5/16, mean_rank 2.0 - beats turtler, does NOT beat the incumbent
outcome.incumbent_replication: flood_pivot 8/16 wins mean_rank 1.875 (batch-003: 5/8, 1.50) - n=24 across two batches
outcome.verdict: stickiness is not the improvement; the incumbent's dual hp/count pressure triggers capture 'punished enough' better than 'any contact'. True dwell-time / 2-consecutive-check hysteresis remains untested (needs the history-dependent trigger extension)

evidence: batch-003: flood_pivot 5/8 wins mean_rank 1.50 (pivots t10-t30 on pressure, 6/8 single clean switch); turtle_pivot 0/8 mean_rank 3.875 (deterministic t30 clock switch, zero post-pivot foundings); flash audit timing_sensible=False for both; batch-004 results.md per-strategy table

statement: The t20-30 science freeze is a catalog artifact, not a strategy equilibrium: every doctrine's list IS the tier-1 catalog, so 'list exhausted' and 'nothing left to research' coincided. With a tier-2 catalog (6 techs) and a cheapest-first overflow fallback, science continues past list exhaustion in every seat.
prediction: In batch-005 (batch-004 roster verbatim, fresh seeds, overflow on): every seat researches >=4 techs beyond its list by t160; mean_scalar rises for every doctrine vs batch-004; the ranking order (flood_pivot first) is preserved; the late-game unit treadmill shrinks or converts production share back to economy.

test.param: TECHS tier-2 + scripted cheapest-first overflow fallback

outcome.ranking: champion preserved on wins (8 v 7) but sticky ties mean_rank 1.875; turtler fell 3->1 wins
refinements: economy axis ADDITIVE not substitutive (unit treadmill persists at med 158-174)
overflow rewards wide-and-late profiles; pure turtler loses relatively
